name: csa-loom-sharing
description: CSA Loom Sharing — the OSS Delta Sharing reference server (delta-io/delta-sharing, Apache-2.0) packaged for Azure Government over the same ADLS Gen2 Delta tables the Loom lakehouse writes. Thin config-rendering overlay on the official deltaio/delta-sharing-server image: fail-closed server bearer, OAuth-only ADLS access, short credential lifetimes. Internal ingress only — recipients authenticate to the Loom Console with Microsoft Entra tokens, which is where per-recipient share scoping is enforced. Azure-native, no Microsoft Fabric dependency.
